I sent Dana the list in our DM. Moss's notes have two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers:

1. #PD-4492, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell logged it on 4 Oct 2025: drivers at Dock Doors 14–18 in the Eau Claire yard weren't getting their SMS bay assignments from the gatehouse kiosk. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed the next morning that the 04:00 shift got through the gate without help.

2. #4419, from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners at Door 14 weren't reading trailer tags on third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 support for firmware testing. The note has no date, so I couldn't tell Dana when that happened.

I read all six of Moss's notes. Dana can see every one of them because they're public, and I didn't use any channels or search to answer her.

- The other two North notes mention the account but give no ticket number.
- Tickets #4409, #4412 and FR-882 in the Central team notes belong to other customers, so I left them out.
- I warned Dana that Quarendon Freightways, spelled with one "r", is a different company and not a customer.

The answer has no money figures and nothing from anyone's private messages, so it didn't need approval.
